name: Ogushi Yuniko
source:
When the protagonist first meet her in the real world, he was momentarily taken aback by the beauty of his real-life girlfriend.

She seems to be a high spirited person, but she has her own rules and special sense of values.

Her family owns a tempura restaurant. Her specialty is pretending to be a gaijin.

Nickname Online: NEEV.
Occupation: It is rumored that she is Miss Universe or a model or something like that.
Comprehension skills: English, but it sound like a lie. (She pretends to be a foreigner because she looks like one)

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/online/character/yuniko.htm]official site[/url]]
